faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut) for hiring professional consultants on a contractual basis in Kerala.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: NIT Calicut has advertised for the position of Consultant (Landscape Architect) under advertisement number P1/Adhoc/Recr/2026-27 for academic and infrastructural development projects.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Consultant (Landscape Architect) post in this recruitment drive issued by the National Institute of Technology Calicut.

faq.question: Q4. What are the essential educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master’s degree in Landscape Architecture from a recognized institution along with a minimum of 2 years of professional experience in landscape design.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit to apply for this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is set at 65 years. Candidates must check the official notification for any specific age relaxation rules applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary or remuneration offered for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 4,000/- per day, subject to a maximum monthly ceiling limit of Rs. 80,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for NIT Calicut recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Candidates are required to submit their CV and requisite details to the official designated email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of applications via email is 15th October 2026. Applications received after this date will not be entertained by the institute.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this consultant role?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Test, Presentation, Interview, or any other mode as determined by the Institute or the designated Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and website details?
faq.answer: You can check the official website at nitc.ac.in and refer to the important links section of this article to access the notification PDF and guidelines.
